blocks.text: One star system per match, picked in the lobby.
blocks.title: Systems

blocks.text: Every player starts with three belts of their own.
blocks.title: Belts

blocks.text: A system keeps its star, signature feature and character, but its seed reshuffles the details.
blocks.title: Every match is different

blocks.text: Every system has a sun at its centre, ringed by a radiation zone that hurts anything inside.
blocks.title: The star

blocks.text: Radiation around the sun hurts every ship inside it, whoever owns it.
blocks.title: Radiation
